claim: SLEEP is the scheduler sleep entry — it stores the tick count into the current process record.
MKPROC creates a process record.
IRQ is the interrupt handler entry; its first act clears the map control.
COLIDE walks the object list for collision detection.
SNDOUT is the sound-command output entry of the sound sequencer.
DEFB6 opens with the UFO PROCESS START — enemies are scheduler processes in this module.
MAPCH7 is a bank-select helper loading block number 7.
Block 1's $C000 vector table starts with JMP HALLOF (hall-of-fame entry).
Block 1's second entry vector is JMP SCNR — the scanner.
HALLOF begins by killing all processes — the hall-of-fame / attract entry routine.

source.verbatim: HALLOF	JSR	GNCIDE	KILL ALL PROCESSES

claim: MESS0's own TTL line names it the MESSAGE BLOCK — the module-side identity for banked block 2.
WTEXTB is the write-text-block entry.

source.verbatim: WTEXTB	PSHS	U,Y,X,D,CC <=START HERE TO WRITE TEXT BLOCK

claim: WTEXTC is the write-text-character entry.

source.verbatim: WTEXTC	PSHS	U,Y,X,D,CC <=START HERE TO WRITE TEXT CHARACTER

claim: BLK71's own header names TERRAIN , MINI-TERRAIN DATA — the module-side identity for banked block 7.
Block 7's vector table opens with JMP BGINIT — terrain generation.
The wave data table WVTAB is published as an FDB in the block-7 vector table.
SAMEXAP7's header names SAM EXPLOSIONS AND APPEARANCES — the materialize/explode effects module.
RESET begins PIA setup by clearing the map control.
The CMOS ledger allocates SLOT1 — the left coin total — among the coin/pricing bookkeeping.
CREDIT is a pricing equate at $A037.
ROMC0's own TTL names it the DIAG ROM AT C000 — the module-side identity for the diagnostics block.

source.verbatim: TTL	ROMC0 - DIAG ROM AT C000 - 12/22/80

claim: ROMC8's own TTL names it the DIAG ROM UPPER HALF.

source.verbatim: TTL	ROMC8 - DIAG ROM UPPER HALF - 12/22/80
